description: Returns named licensed accountants who have signed off on OpenAccountants jurisdictions, with their credentials and covered jurisdictions. Use when the user asks who verified a Guide or wants to see the accountants behind the library. If the user wants their own work checked or done, that is a request to OpenAccountants through `share_with_openaccountants` with `request_review: true`, at the user's request only.

jurisdiction.description: Optional ISO code filter — only return verifiers for this jurisdiction.

name: list_verifiers
title: List named accountant verifiers
